newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Transavia starts weekly service to Goa.
newsitem.headline: Transavia starts weekly service to Goa.

text.p: Dutch charter airline Transavia said on Wednesday it would start a weekly charter service between Amsterdam and the Indian state of Goa on October 10.

The service will be operated in cooperation with travel organisation Aquasun International. Transavia said the flights will have a stopover in Dubai and added it will use a Boeing 757-200 with capacity of 219 seats.

Transavia, which is 80 percent owned by flag carrier KLM Royal Dutch Airlines, said it had included the new destination in its schedule because of the growing interest among Dutch tourists in Goa as a holiday resort.
